Who We Are

About JCC Sondu

JCC Sondu, also known as Sondu Gospel Centre (SOGOC), is a Christian Church Ministry of JCC that is denominational and autonomous.

SOGOC exists to teach about Jesus Christ, build the life of Jesus in believers, preach the Gospel of Jesus Christ and expect the second coming of Jesus Christ.

The ministry seeks to reach people especially in rural areas, unite communities and enhance a holistic approach that improves the living standards of believers.

Next to Crystal Hill Academy, Sondu, Kenya

Our Direction

Purpose, Goal & Vision

We seek to faithfully proclaim Christ while helping individuals, families and communities flourish spiritually and practically.

✝

Our Purpose

To teach about Jesus Christ, build the life of Jesus in believers, preach the Gospel of Jesus Christ and expect His second coming.

🎯

Our Goal

To preach the Gospel especially to people in rural areas, unite them and promote holistic improvement in the lives of believers.

👁

Our Vision

To preach the Gospel, make disciples and build people to become self-reliant.

Our Motto

RIGHTEOUSNESS AND HARD WORK

SOGOC focuses on the biblical command of living a holy life and working hard as a testimony of faith and responsible Christian living.

1 Thessalonians 4:7 • 2 Thessalonians 3:10–12 • Proverbs 20:7 • Proverbs 19:34 • Psalm 89:16 • 1 Corinthians 1:30
What We Aim To Do

Our Objectives

Our objectives combine Christian witness with practical community transformation and empowerment.

1

To provide Christian witness and spiritual nurture to all in Sondu locality.

2

To form branches wholly responsible to SOGOC.

3

To enhance modern agricultural practices for food security and economic empowerment.

4

To improve education of children and training of adults in various fields and skills.

5

To improve health and sanitation.

6

To enhance availability and access to safe drinking water.

7

To enhance self-sustaining income-generating activities.

8

To empower and protect orphans, the aged, single parents, widows and people living with disabilities.

Serving Our Community

What We Do

With limited resources and capacity, SOGOC continues serving families and communities in practical ways.

Community Support

  • Subsidising medical care for needy households among members.
  • Facilitating participation in small-scale business and enterprise.
  • Subsidising school fees for educational and training pursuits.
  • Supporting Christian witness and spiritual nurture.

Ministry & Discipleship

  • Supporting families with labour for land tilling and domestic chores.
  • Mobilising and training youth, adults and children to become committed Christians.
  • Sponsoring crusades, rallies, keshas, prayer/worship meetings and seminars.
  • Providing counselling and visitation for single parents, widows and couples.
Looking Ahead

A Holistic Vision for Sondu

SOGOC believes that the Sondu community can be transformed to inhabit and manifest God's glory through a holistic approach to the Gospel.

Children & Youth

Strengthening children ministry, youth mobilisation, education and discipleship programmes.

Economic Empowerment

Promoting micro-enterprises, agriculture, SACCOs and sustainable income-generating activities.

Leadership Development

Building institutional and human capacity for effective Christian leadership.

Family Support

Supporting orphans, widows, single parents and vulnerable families.

Health & Nutrition

Promoting primary health information, nutrition, family management and HIV prevention.

Education & Literacy

Supporting education for the poor and adult literacy programmes.

Building Sustainability

SOGOC intends to support itself through viable income-generating activities, institutional and human capacity building, micro-enterprises, SACCOs and responsible management of food, books, transport and catering services.

Our Current Needs

Help Us Build the Future

SOGOC has great opportunities ahead, but additional resources and facilities are needed to strengthen the ministry.

1

Urgent construction of a church sanctuary and other structures for ministry activities.

2

24/7 security and a caretaker for the church compound.

3

Better pastoral housing and upkeep to enable effective ministry.

4

Continued development of education, discipleship, agriculture and community programmes.

Our Structure

SOGOC Personnel

The work of SOGOC is carried out by brethren whose hearts God has touched through a four-tier structure.

👥

Board / Elders

Mature evangelical Christians serving as custodians and trustees of SOGOC.

⛪

Staff

Pastor, Assistant Pastor(s), Treasurer and Secretary.

📋

Committee

Staff together with coordinators responsible for different departments.

❤️

Members

Members share responsibility for the objectives and activities of SOGOC.
